quarterly_opex.note: quad witching; S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 quarterly rebalances trade at this close

vix_expiry.note: VIX options and futures settle on this morning's SPX opening quotes

leveraged_etfs.units: USD of index exposure traded at the close; positive = buy

pension_rebalance.note: positive drift = stocks overweight vs 60/40, so rebalancing sells stocks into the period end; the percentile ranks the period so far against completed periods, so it reads low early on

vol_control.note: model: 10% vol target, EWMA lambda 0.94, leverage cap 2.0x; a negative change means these funds sell at the close

borrow.note: change = shortable shares vs five sessions earlier; shortable_vs_adv = shortable shares over 20-day average volume; hard_to_borrow = IBKR's shortable indicator at or below 2.5
